title: M2 (CH264) J3 read-out resolution fetch (MEASUREMENT_M2_CH264.md 9.4): Gamma /markets?id= in batches of 50 with closed=true, a second pass without the filter, a single-id re-query with and without closed=true before any not_found, up to 3 attempts at least 1 h apart, parse_outcome at the pinned calibration.py; on or after READOUT_UTC
expected_value: the resolution classes of 8.1 for every unit and for every no_favourite market (resolved, split, pending, not_found, unavailable) for the analysis; about 60-200 requests
data: data-dumps/research_lab/m2_ch264/ (units/, nofav/, manifest.json; read-only); writes readout/ (write-once)
notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/). Refuses before READOUT_UTC (2027-01-29T00:00Z, or the slid date in the registration commit), without the J2 unit manifest, on a pin mismatch, and over an existing read-out. not_found needs three answers: no record in the closed=true batch, none in the batch without the filter, and then two HTTP 200 answers without the record from the single-id queries (with and without closed=true); a failed single query leaves the unit unavailable_fetch. A record that is not closed is pending for every final state (y null when downgraded); other_price_vector and bad_prices are named unavailable sub-classes. The 1 h gap between attempts is slept inside the job (timeout 8 h covers the passes). If the slide rule moved the dates, edit not_before in the registration commit only. Code: backend/scripts/run_m2.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m2_spec.py, m2_j1.py, m2_j2.py, m2_readout.py, m2_analysis.py; pins checked at start (exit 3 / exit 2 as for J1).
